exceptions.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-22: the vendored libavif-sys keeps rav1e 0.7.1 to preserve the encoder ABI and output behavior. Both rav1e 0.7.1 and the available 0.8.1 still depend on paste; upgrading alone does not remove this warning.
exceptions.impact: This is an unmaintained proc-macro warning, not a known runtime vulnerability. The root graph compiles it through the pinned AVIF backend; the fuzz lock also resolves it through optional image/ravif/rav1e metadata even though those runtime features are disabled. It is not exposed to image input at runtime.
exceptions.remediation: Remove this exception when a reviewed rav1e release replaces paste and image/ravif no longer retains it in either lockfile. Re-check the active root and fuzz graphs before the review deadline; do not extend without reassessing them.
